dialogue.speaker: Mira
dialogue.text: Hey, don't look around, but I think they're watching us. Just talk normally. What do you think about McDonald's in Vietnam?

dialogue.speaker: Michael
dialogue.text: Really? Who's watching us? About McDonald's, I think it's not as good as in America, but Vietnamese người seem to thích it.

dialogue.speaker: Mira
dialogue.text: Those people wearing black in that corner. I think McDonald's here is too expensive. We Russians thích traditional food more than fast food.

dialogue.speaker: Michael
dialogue.text: I understand. Vietnamese người are the same, they still thích phở and cơm tấm more than burgers. But McDonald's is a symbol of modernity, so people still visit it.

dialogue.speaker: Mira
dialogue.text: Maybe so, but I don't understand why people have to queue for so long just to eat low-quality fast food. Do you often eat at McDonald's?
